purpose: Define BR204 FULL178 resume-first execution with 250 durable (b,d-band) outer units, exact single-d inner checkpoints, soft-deadline partial preservation, paginated recovery, transitive complete-prefix carry, partial-slice carry bundles, and automatic execution only from a dedicated runkey-only push after fresh audit.

audited_predecessor.scope: previous push-trigger cold doorstep; superseded because generation-1 execution exposed a Research OS resume defect: in-progress b x d-band work was not checkpointed below the outer unit

live_main_refresh.execution_freshness_rule: Heavy authorize must fetch origin/main and require this exact repository_main_head and MAIN-STATE blob. Any later main movement fails closed and requires a new cold doorstep refresh before execution.

objective_semantics.per_unit_output: Each durable (b,d-band) subunit emits exact merged (s,B,capacity) bins for BR202 K8 and BR203 mu plus d-dependent L>8/K8-tail-slot counters. Static BC state/mass metadata are repeated per band, must agree byte-semantically within b, and are counted once per b by the aggregator.
objective_semantics.k8_tail_slot_semantics: For a compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels, parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 is the K8 relaxed slot containing exact level 8 plus all deeper-level mass evaluated at q8. Do not reinterpret the slot as only qBC levels >8.
objective_semantics.global_composition: validate exact coverage of the approved 250 (b,d-band) subunits; count static BC population once per b; union all d-dependent exact capacities across subunits; group bins by exact rational ratio s/B; then solve one descending exact-rational ratio-class LP against the retained envelope
objective_semantics.equal_ratio_rule: Forced tail selection is computed only after summing capacity and tail-slot capacity over every bin with the same exact Fraction(s,B), so attribution is representation/order independent.
objective_semantics.forbidden: sum or average per-b LP floors; order equal-ratio bins to manufacture tail activity; materialize raw 4.1M routing-state JSON; terminal-identity fallback

qbc_tail_certificate.per_subunit_commitment: SHA256 of the complete validated (b,d-band) stream, including b/d-band/source locks and TAIL fields
global_checks: approved d bands are pairwise disjoint and cover every admissible even d exactly once for each b
all repeated static state/mass/tail metadata agree across bands of the same b and are counted exactly once per b
L<=8 plus L>8 static base-state partition equals H96 compact-state census
mu tail-slot capacities are subsets of mu capacities and mu<=K8
global ratio-class forced-tail attribution is exact and order independent
qbc_tail_certificate.br205_gate_firewall: Heavy result may emit raw and stronger tail-activity candidates, but formal BR205 gate remains false until the heavy result is hostile-audited and separately promoted.

resume_contract.checkpoint_rule: Execute one exact admissible even d at a time. After every completed d, persist a source-locked single-d compact certificate in runner-local recovery state. Before the GitHub hard timeout, stop starting new d work at the soft deadline, upload every completed single-d slice as the partial checkpoint for that outer band, and deliberately mark the job incomplete so the generation is recovery-eligible.
resume_contract.partial_artifact_rule: At most one compact rolled partial-band certificate plus state JSON per incomplete outer band. Exact single-d slices are runner-local checkpoints and are folded into that cumulative partial before upload; later generations resume from the rolled aggregate and compute only missing d values.
resume_contract.generation_start_recovery: For generation >=2, recover the immediately previous BR204 run's complete prefix, completed br204-u-* outer units, inherited br204-partials bundle, and current br204-p-* rolled partial-band artifacts. Validate and re-emit complete and partial recovery unions before new compute.
resume_contract.reuse_rule: A complete outer unit is reused only after exact existing aggregator validation. A rolled partial band is reused only after source locks, band identity, completed/missing-d coverage, TAIL/SUM invariants, and aggregate raw digest validation. New work computes only missing d values and rolls them into the prior partial aggregate.
resume_contract.timeout_rule: SOFT_DEADLINE partials are normal recovery. A SINGLE_D_TIMEOUT_REQUIRES_FINER_PARTITION status is a hard stop: do not blindly rerun or extend timeout; introduce a finer exact execution-only partition before another heavy generation.
resume_contract.cancellation_semantics: Completed outer-unit artifacts survive independently. Manual cancellation may lose only runner-local work since the last uploaded outer/partial checkpoint; automatic hard timeout is guarded by the soft deadline and must not be the normal checkpoint path.
resume_contract.pilot_salvage: The two representative pilots use the same single-d checkpoint runner and each uploads either a complete outer unit or a reusable partial-band checkpoint.
resume_contract.cleanup_rule: Only after both the complete prefix and any partial-slice carry bundle are successfully re-emitted may superseded prior BR204 recovery artifacts be deleted. Cleanup failure is a hard stop before new heavy compute.

storage_contract.bin_stream_note: Complete outer units persist compact merged band certificates. Incomplete outer units persist one compact rolled partial-band certificate plus coverage state; raw routing-state streams and per-d artifacts are not persisted across runs.
storage_contract.high_mass_scaleout_gate: Both representative pilots must complete under the exact single-d checkpoint runner. Measure both final band gzip size and the sum of all pilot single-d slice gzip sizes; use the larger per-band recovery-slot measurement for the scaleout projection.
storage_contract.projection_rule: Each of the 250 outer bands occupies at most one recovery slot: either one complete-band gzip or one rolled-partial gzip, each <=900000 bytes. At rollover at most two 250-slot unions coexist, plus 20 MiB.
storage_contract.absolute_peak_rule: Each of the 250 outer bands occupies at most one <=900000-byte recovery slot, complete or partial. At generation rollover at most one prior recovery union and one re-emitted/current recovery union coexist, plus 20 MiB fixed overhead.
storage_contract.recovery_retention: All BR204 recovery artifacts use 1-day retention, but superseded prior recovery artifacts are actively deleted after successful prefix re-emission so repeated generations do not accumulate one-day copies.

authorization.initial_execution_rule: After fresh hostile-audit PASS on this rebuilt cold doorstep, one runkey-only commit changes generation 0->1 and armed false->true, binds the audited rebuilt doorstep head/review, and auto-starts heavy.
authorization.recovery_execution_rule: After a recovery-eligible generation fails/cancels/times out because of ordinary interruption or explicit SOFT_DEADLINE partial jobs, a runkey-only child names that immediate prior run and resumes validated complete units plus single-d partial checkpoints. SINGLE_D_TIMEOUT_REQUIRES_FINER_PARTITION is not eligible for blind resume.

required_checks: 250 outer-unit exact coverage/disjointness over approved b x d-band units
every admissible even d covered exactly once per b
every recovered partial single-d checkpoint source-locks to the current worker and exact d identity
recovery discovery counts distinguish artifact enumeration from mathematical missing work
complete prefix plus partial-slice carry bundle re-emits before new compute
both pilots measure complete-band and single-d partial recovery footprints below the 900000-byte slot cap
H96 refined-state census counted once per b
H96 BC assignment-mass conservation counted once per b
global mu LP <= global K8 LP
post_run_gates.br205_gate: Only after the heavy result establishes exact FULL178 L>8/tail-slot activity and, for the stronger diagnostic, positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity under the order-independent global LP; any formal BR205 authorization additionally requires hostile audit.
post_run_gates.main_credit: requires separate hostile audit and MAIN MIN/replacement consumption; never automatic

audit_hold.defect: Outer b x d-band units were durable only after full completion; work completed inside a long-running outer unit was not checkpointed before hard timeout.
